comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors no more than 1.5 points below measured coverage, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/repo/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-09-23 with --all over every included source file: 63.51 lines/statements, 83.60 branches, and 85.59 functions over 4627 passing tests (6 pending).
vendoredExclusion: src/hub/** is excluded from the measurement (the --exclude flag rides alongside --include in both the coverage and coverage:check scripts). That directory holds nothing but the two byte-identical vendored copies of the hub-DB mirror client, hub_db_sync.js and hub_schema_version.js, which xchain-indexer/bin/sync-hub-mirror-client.sh overwrites from its canonical src/hub and whose --check step fails CI on any drift. The explorer may not edit them, so it cannot give them explorer-specific tests without drifting the twin, and their logic is covered by the canonical's own suites in the indexer; the same reasoning already carries them out of the structural ratchet via vendorPaths. Only this vendored directory is excluded, so a coverage regression anywhere the explorer actually owns still reddens the ratchet.
